description: Historia sobre el equipo desechado de la Nasa en la Luna y Marte
summary:
In this project, I researched space probes and their missions, including several that are often forgotten today.
I also focused on the Lunar Roving Vehicles because I was fascinated by the fact that they ran on electricity. Since there is no oxygen on the Moon, standard combustion engines cannot burn fuel to work. What makes this even more impressive is that in the early 1970s, the automotive industry on Earth was heavily dominated by gasoline-powered cars, making electric vehicles rare for everyday use.
Overall, these Lunar Roving Vehicles remain an amazing achievement in space engineering
details:
We did this project based on research of NASA's Surveyor 3 mission, a probe that was used to collect samples from the lunar surface.

We wanted to motivate people to discover and look at the sky.

The impact was discovering that the Lunar Roving Vehicles worked with electricity, because there was no oxygen to start combustion to make fire. So it is a technology that looks very futuristic for the year when the cars drove on the Moon.

However, land vehicles already used electricity, although they were not that common or famous I used my imagination for my descriptions and I used Al to translate the text. I used Canva on my cell phone and my tablet, but the best part was having fun and letting my creativity flow.
